# graphiant_user (Data Source)

Looks up a single Graphiant user by ID (email).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_user" "jane" {
  id = "jane@example.com"
}

output "jane_group_verified" {
  value = data.graphiant_user.jane.verified
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String)
- `id` (String) User identifier. Equal to the user's email address.

### Read-Only

- `enterprise_id` (Number)
- `first_name` (String)
- `last_active_at` (String)
- `last_name` (String)
- `mfa_factor` (String)
- `phone_number` (String)
- `time_zone` (String)
- `verified` (Boolean)
